_chunk.purpose: Canonical visual descriptions for image generation and reconstruction

_schema.description: Detailed character visual specifications for LLM image-to-image reconstruction
_schema.usage: Feed to Gemini 2.0 Flash with reference image generation for consistent character appearance

build.description: Weathered but capable. Not bulky, but every muscle is functional. Moves like someone who's survived a lot of fights.
build.shoulders: Broad, slightly hunched from years of tension
build.posture: Alert, weight slightly forward, always ready to move

face.description: Sharp jawline, prominent cheekbones. A face that's taken punches and given them back.

skin.texture: Rough, with visible pores. Fine lines around eyes and mouth.
notable: Old scar across left cheekbone, thin white line

eyes.description: Deep-set, tired but sharp. Always scanning, assessing. The eyes of someone who's seen too much.

right_eye.description: Mechanical-framed holographic monocle. Brass-toned frame with cyan holographic lens. Covers entire right eye.
right_eye.glow: Subtle cyan glow from lens, brightens when active

eyebrows.description: Thick, slightly unkempt. Often furrowed in thought or suspicion

nose.description: Strong nose, slightly crooked from old break. Character, not flaw.

mouth.description: Rarely smiles. When he does, it doesn't reach his eyes. Usually set in a grim line.

jaw.description: Strong jawline, defining feature. Shows tension when stressed.

ears.notable: Small notch in left earlobe (old injury)

hair.description: Short, practical cut that's grown out a bit. Gray dominant with darker streaks. Perpetually slightly disheveled - he runs his hand through it when thinking.
hair.hairline: Intact but slightly receded at temples

facial_hair.description: 2-3 day stubble, never clean-shaven, never a full beard. Silver and dark mixed.

right_arm.name: Holographic Arm Mk.III
right_arm.description: Full arm replacement from shoulder. Translucent cyan holographic shell with visible tech internals.

visual_details.shell: Semi-transparent cyan energy field, slightly flickering at edges
visual_details.internals: Visible mechanical components - servo motors, power conduits, data cables
visual_details.joints: Segmented at shoulder, elbow, wrist. Cyan energy lines at joint gaps
visual_details.hand: Five articulated fingers, same holographic construction. Can phase through objects briefly.
visual_details.glow_intensity: Constant subtle glow, brightens during use

right_arm.attachment_point: Clean transition at shoulder, slight scarring visible at edge

right_eye_monocle.description: Mechanical-framed holographic display over right eye

visual_details.frame: Brass-toned mechanical frame, visible gears and micro-adjustments
visual_details.lens: Cyan holographic projection, displays data overlay
visual_details.attachment: Wraps around temple and behind ear
visual_details.glow: Cyan glow when active, dims when inactive

coat.description: Long gray trench coat, weathered and worn. Multiple hidden pockets. Collar often turned up.
coat.condition: Faded, small tears repaired, water stains at hem

shirt.description: Dark charcoal v-neck, simple and practical

undershirt.description: Concealed ballistic weave underneath, barely visible

pants.description: Black tactical pants, reinforced knees, multiple pockets
pants.fit: Practical, allows full range of motion

boots.description: Black leather combat boots, steel-toed, worn but maintained

stealth.description: All black tactical gear, no coat, more form-fitting

civilian.description: Same pants and boots, gray henley shirt instead of v-neck, no coat

always.description: Slim black band with small holographic display

often.description: Unlit, usually tucked behind ear or in corner of mouth
often.note: He quit, but keeps one for emergencies that never come

accent.name: Cyan
accent.usage: Cybernetics, tech glow, holographic elements ONLY

color_palette.restriction: NO colors outside this palette. Scene should be 85% grayscale with cyan accents only.

neutral_standing.description: Weight on back foot, shoulders slightly hunched, hands in coat pockets or at sides. Head slightly tilted, assessing.

alert.description: Weight forward, right arm (holographic) slightly raised, monocle glowing brighter. Ready for anything.

conversation.description: Arms crossed or one hand touching chin. Rarely makes eye contact for long.

combat.description: Low stance, holographic arm glowing bright, pistol drawn. Fluid movement.

expression_library.thinking: Eyes unfocused, hand touches holographic arm
expression_library.suspicious: Narrowed eyes, one eyebrow slightly raised
expression_library.angry: Jaw clenched, eyes hard, very still
expression_library.rare_smile: One corner of mouth slightly up, eyes still guarded
expression_library.pain: Controlled, barely visible wince, refuses to show weakness

movement_style.walk: Measured, purposeful. Slightly favors left leg. Always aware of surroundings.
movement_style.run: Efficient, low. Years of training evident.
movement_style.fight: Brutal efficiency. No wasted movement. Uses holographic arm for both offense and defense.

reference_shots_needed.description: Full body front view, neutral standing pose, coat slightly open to show v-neck
Upper body three-quarter view, clearly showing monocle and holographic arm
Closeup of face showing monocle detail, stubble, scar, and expression
Detailed view of right arm showing internal components and cyan glow
Right profile clearly showing monocle attachment

generation_prompt_template.base: Clean Modern cyberpunk scene: Noir detective, rugged mid-40s, salt-and-pepper stubble. Long gray weathered trench coat, dark charcoal v-neck, black boots. Right arm is a translucent cyan holographic cybernetic with visible tech internals. Wears a mechanical-framed cyan holographic monocle over right eye.
generation_prompt_template.style_suffix: MANDATORY STYLE: 85% grayscale, high contrast noir. ONLY cyan (#00CED1) for neon/tech/cybernetic accents. Deep black shadows, art deco architecture. Cinematic composition, dramatic lighting. NO bright colors except cyan.
